text:
Mina T: quick copy review for the 'Disconnect connector' flow. Support reports users confused whether disconnect deletes stored data. mock: https://redwood.design/disconnect-connector-sketch :paperclip:
Evelyn R: good call. we need a clear heading + a short explainer + an explicit consequence line. also the primary CTA label matters a lot here.
Devon P: CTA candidates:
  1) `Disconnect connector` (literal)
  2) `Disconnect and remove data` (explicit, longer)
  3) `Disconnect (keep data)` vs `Disconnect and delete data` (two-step radio)
Mina T: product wants a single confirmation dialog (not radios) unless user checks a "Delete stored files" checkbox. default should be safer: disconnect preserves data unless user opts in to delete.
Evelyn R: then dialog copy should surface that default. Heading candidates:
  - `Disconnect connector?`
  - `Disconnect <connector name>?`
  - `Disconnect and stop syncing?`
Devon P: prefer `Disconnect <connector name>?` — it's specific and shows context. body: we need two short sentences: one about stopping sync, one about stored data. e.g. `This will stop new data from being synced from <connector name>. Your previously synced data will remain unless you choose to delete it.`
Mina T: +1. Add a small checkbox option under the body: `[ ] Also delete previously synced data (irreversible)` with helper text: `This removes files and indexed artifacts created from this connector.` That keeps the default non-destructive.
Evelyn R: microcopy nit for checkbox label: avoid parentheses. maybe: `Also delete previously synced data — irreversible` or `Also delete previously synced data (cannot be undone)` — which reads better?
Devon P: `(cannot be undone)` is explicit and common. shorter helper: `Removes files and search/index artifacts created from this connector.`
Design Bot: accessibility checklist: 1) checkbox must be reachable by keyboard and included in `aria-describedby` for the dialog 2) primary CTA should reflect the choice: if checkbox unchecked -> `Disconnect connector`, if checked -> `Disconnect and delete data` (aria-label should mirror full sentence) 3) when deletion is chosen, require an additional typed confirmation for large connectors (e.g., type connector name) to avoid accidental wipes 4) ensure the danger CTA has proper contrast and `aria-live` announces result on success/failure.
Mina T: good. proposal for final copy blocks:
  - heading: `Disconnect Acme Drive?`
  - body: `This will stop new files from syncing from Acme Drive. Your previously synced files and indexes will remain unless you choose to delete them.`
  - checkbox label: `Also delete previously synced data (cannot be undone)`
  - checkbox helper: `Removes files and search/index artifacts created from this connector.`
  - primary CTA (unchecked): `Disconnect connector` (aria-label: `Disconnect Acme Drive, keep previously synced data`)
  - primary CTA (checked): `Disconnect and delete data` (aria-label: `Disconnect Acme Drive and delete previously synced data`)
  - secondary CTA: `Cancel`
Evelyn R: small tone nit: `Disconnect connector` reads slightly technical. maybe `Disconnect` alone is fine if heading includes the connector name. but product likes explicitness. Leave as-is.
Devon P: add a progressive confirmation for connectors with >10k files: after user checks delete, show a small extra confirm modal asking them to type the connector name. label: `Type "Acme Drive" to confirm deletion.`
Design Bot: recommended aria patterns: use `role="alertdialog"` for the delete confirmation, include `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby`, set focus to the text input when the extra confirm appears, and ensure the typed-confirmation input has `aria-required="true"`. Also include an `aria-live="polite"` toast that says `Connector disconnected. Previously synced data preserved.` or `Connector disconnected and data deleted.` depending on action.
Mina T: ok i'll update the mock and add exact aria-label examples in the PR. one more: wording for the success toast depending on path? suggested toasts:
  - keep data: `Disconnected Acme Drive. Previously synced files remain available.`
  - delete data: `Disconnected Acme Drive and deleted previously synced files.`
Evelyn R: tiny copy nit on toast: keep it short — `Disconnected Acme Drive. Previously synced files remain.` and `Disconnected Acme Drive and deleted synced files.`
Devon P: approved with typed-confirmation rule and toast variants. :white_check_mark:
Evelyn R: approved. :white_check_mark:
Design Bot: decision recorded: default disconnect preserves data; checkbox `Also delete previously synced data (cannot be undone)` exposes destructive option; primary CTA updates based on checkbox; typed-confirmation required for large connectors; aria patterns and toast copy examples included. Mina will land copy in the PR with examples for aria-labels.
